templates.source: https://web.archive.org/web/20140330095606/http://toshibasecurity.com/pdf/_manuals/IK-WB81A_UserManual_v1.00.pdf — Toshiba IK-WB81A User Manual (archived), Network > Streaming protocols > RTSP Streaming: URL format rtsp://<ip address>:<rtsp port>/<access name for stream1 ~ 5>, default access name for stream 1 = live.sdp, RTSP port 554 (same defaults in the IK-WB16A/WB30A/WB70A/WB80A/WD04A/WD12A/WR04A/WR12A/WR14A manuals).

https://web.archive.org/web/20140330095606/http://toshibasecurity.com/pdf/_manuals/IK-WB81A_UserManual_v1.00.pdf — Toshiba IK-WB81A User Manual (archived), RTSP Streaming settings: default access name for stream 2 = live2.sdp (also shown in the IK-WB70A User Manual).

https://web.archive.org/web/20140330095606/http://toshibasecurity.com/pdf/_manuals/IK-WB81A_UserManual_v1.00.pdf — Toshiba IK-WB81A User Manual (archived), RTSP Streaming settings: default access name for stream 3 = live3.sdp (stream 4 = live4.sdp, stream 5 = liveany.sdp).

notes: Toshiba Surveillance IK-W series IP cameras (IK-WB16A/WB30A/WB70A/WB80A/WB81A, IK-WD04A/WD12A/WD14A, IK-WR04A/WR12A/WR14A). The RTSP access names are user-configurable in Configuration > Network > Streaming protocols; the paths here are the factory defaults shown in the manuals. Older two-stream models (e.g. IK-WB70A) only expose live.sdp and live2.sdp. The IK-WP41A PTZ uses a different firmware whose manual documents rtsp://<ip>:554/livestream; that record carries its own template.
